summary: Iteration-10 backend testing of NEW Zitex features: Loyalty Points (earn+redeem+history), Group Buy CRUD (list/join/merchant create/delete), Notifications (list/read/read-all/push-token), Order-status auto-notify, and merchant-only permission checks. All 15 executed tests passed (1 skipped on duplicate-join because customer was already a participant from a prior run — expected idempotent behavior). Tests run against local backend (http://localhost:8001) because frontend EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL still points to an older Railway deploy that does NOT include these new endpoints.

minor.issue: Returns wrapped {"user": {...}} object — inconsistent with /api/profile and earn-time order response which return flat user/order objects. Frontend code reading me.wallet_balance directly will see undefined.
points_earned key is omitted when subtotal < 10 SAR (i.e. earned == 0). Spec says response should include the field; consider always returning 0 for stable contracts.
Arabic error string is "انضممت مسبقاً" but review request expected substring "joined مسبقاً". Functionally fine, but test scripts comparing the English token need to use the Arabic substring.

integration_issues.issue: frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://api-production-df2ce.up.railway.app does NOT yet include the iteration-10 endpoints (/api/group-buys, /api/points/*, /api/notifications/*). Curl on Railway returns 404 for /api/group-buys. Mobile UI will fail if pointed at production until Railway is redeployed.

action_items: Redeploy Railway backend (or repoint EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) so the mobile client can reach the new /api/group-buys, /api/points/*, /api/notifications/* and /api/push-tokens/* endpoints.
Make /api/auth/me return a flat user dict (consistent with /api/profile) OR document the {user:{...}} wrapper so frontend reads me.user.wallet_balance.
Always include points_earned in POST /api/orders response (default to 0 when subtotal < 10 SAR) for a stable contract.
If you want the 400 message string changed to match the spec verbatim ("joined مسبقاً"), update the HTTPException detail in /api/group-buys/{gid}/join.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2437 lines — exceeds the 700-line recommended size. Split into modules (auth, orders, loyalty, group_buys, notifications, merchant, ...).

create_notification is fire-and-forget but is wrapped in try/except only at the call site; if the notifications collection write fails, the order still succeeds (good), but failures are only logged at warning level — fine for now.
group_buys.list_group_buys does not exclude `product_id` after enriching `product`. Minor; harmless to clients.
Notification title "تم استلام طلبك ✅" embeds an emoji. Substring filtering still works, but consider keeping a stable, machine-readable `data.type` key (already done) for client-side categorization.
/points/redeem allows redemption when points are exactly == requested but does not enforce a minimum (e.g. 10). Consider business rule (10 points = 1 SAR minimum unit).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Created TEST_ orders and notifications via the API during execution; test order is left in DB but only carries TEST_ markers in address/notes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run BACKEND_TEST_URL env override if you need to point pytest at a different backend; defaults to http://localhost:8001 because frontend/.env still references the old Railway deploy. The seeded group buy (id stays constant across runs) means the customer will likely already be a participant — the test_join_success test will SKIP on repeated runs, which is correct; test_join_duplicate still validates the 400 path.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures. The one self-test iteration fix during development was a test-side bug: /api/auth/me wraps the user object in { user: ... } whereas the test assumed a flat shape. Fixed in test helper _wallet().
